punctuation.description: Use locale-dependent punctuation characters as delimiters (e.g., [default] section: `punctuation`)

delimiters.description: List of single characters to use as delimiters (e.g., [default] section: `delimiters ",.!?"`)

white_space.description: List of characters to treat as whitespace (e.g., [default] section: `white-space " \t"`)

start_delete.description: String to mark beginning of deleted text (default: '[-')

stop_delete.description: String to mark end of deleted text (default: '-]')

start_insert.description: String to mark beginning of inserted text (default: '{+')

stop_insert.description: String to mark end of inserted text (default: '+}')

line_numbers.description: Minimum width for line numbers; 0 = disable (e.g., 5 for `line-numbers 5`)

context.description: Number of context lines to show around changes (0 = disable)

match_context.description: Number of words to use for context-aware matching (0 = disable, default: 1)

ignore_formatting.description: Ignore character formatting differences (Unicode compatibility decomposition)

paragraph_separator.description: Marker for paragraph separators between blocks of whitespace-only changes

repeat_markers.description: Repeat delimiters at line boundaries when changes cross newlines
